subcategory_text: Cyber threat intelligence is received from information sharing forums and sources
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: PM-15, PM-16, SI-05
ISO/IEC 27001:2022: Annex A.5.7, Annex A.5.22, Annex A.8.16
CRI Profile v2.0: ID.RA-02, ID.RA-02.01, ID.RA-02.02
implementation_examples: Configure cybersecurity tools and technologies with detection or response capabilities to securely ingest cyber threat intelligence feeds
Receive and review advisories from reputable third parties on current threat actors and their tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs)
Monitor sources of cyber threat intelligence for information on the types of vulnerabilities that emerging technologies may have
assessment_objectives: Determine whether cyber threat intelligence is received from information sharing forums and sources.
Determine whether activities are conducted to configure cybersecurity tools and technologies with detection or response capabilities to securely ingest cyber threat intelligence feeds.
Determine whether mechanisms ensure that receive and review advisories from reputable third parties on current threat actors and their tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
Determine whether implementation outcomes are monitored, evaluated, and documented.
